fresh_study: Matoba et al. 2026, original journal Supplementary Table 3b and physically verified GEO/author constructs
fresh_subset: All 610 eligible original baseline fitted coefficients, including detected and undetected allelic effects. Availability and physical/source audits determine eligibility; no model or outcome-based hit selection.
magnitude_target: Absolute original fitted log2 allelic coefficient. Do not infer its signed convention from genomic reference labels. Do not substitute activity differences or AlphaGenome predictions as test truth.
limitations: Original assay-active subset, not a representative all-variant sample
Primary neural progenitors from one male donor, repeated cultures, not independent people
Source raw barcode QC and coefficient estimation not independently reconstructed
Exact pretrained context matches excluded; full pretrained genomic-neighborhood exclusion not established
No project allele has a matching measured coefficient in this fresh subset
No human insomnia/frailty genetic-score validation or causal-gene test

development_and_locks.model_selection: Development source/locus comparisons only; one common recipe and epoch. All adverse comparisons retained.
development_and_locks.main_final_fit: Refit on original training+validation regions only, with all new-test overlapping whole components excluded; calibration regions remain outside fitting.
development_and_locks.matched_AVI: Identical source rows, target values, epoch count, seeds, shared initial weights and batch curriculum. AVI is appended as raw score, phred and availability after training-only scaling; added input weights start at zero.
before_fresh_performance: Freeze selected architecture, epochs and source data
Freeze all final and source-omitted fitted weights
Save both arms predictions, intervals and eligibility before joining source coefficients
development_and_locks.future_model_changes: A changed model cannot reuse this revealed study as an untouched confirmatory test.

primary_metrics.all_case_magnitude_MAE: Mean absolute error in raw original log2 units; paired comparison with training-only cell median and between model arms.
primary_metrics.ranking: Effect-magnitude Spearman globally and within genomic regions; report nearby pairs separately.
primary_metrics.bootstrap: 2,000 paired resamples of 1-Mb genomic windows, seed 20261108; state that windows approximate dependence and are not ancestry-specific LD blocks.
primary_metrics.cell_differences: On the untouched calibration loci, compare actual matched-cell differences against zero and training-cell median differences; also evaluate within fixed study/cell contrast. These loci are independent of model selection; interval calibration on them is not an independent confidence-coverage test.
primary_metrics.nearby_ordering: Same source experiment and genomic component, within 25 bp. No significance or effect-gap screen. Report unanswered comparisons and uncertainty; individual interval overlap is not a calibrated paired-order guarantee.

uncertainty.error_predictor_training: Predictions made while a whole development study and its genomic components were omitted; fit error predictors using only original training-role observations of those predictions. Calibration-role observations do not choose neural settings.

targets: actual absolute model error, squared-error mean regression
actual absolute cell-median baseline error, squared-error mean regression
0.90 quantile of actual absolute model error

uncertainty.allowed_inputs: Predicted magnitude, signed contrast, mean allele activity, global/local representation summaries, cell/family and number of same-cell training studies. No measured effect, activity, SE, p value or significance label is an inference input.
uncertainty.calibration: Fixed-source-omission predictions on original calibration regions; region-balanced residual/error-scale ratios. Report both observation-weighted and region-balanced coverage and interval width. No universal cross-study guarantee.
not_success: High coverage obtained by withholding every answer
A large number of code checks
Post hoc restriction to favorable variants

AVI_retention_gate.if_insufficient_local_groups: Report insufficient local confirmation; do not claim a safe nearby-ranking improvement. Retention does not establish useful predictions unless the separate quality gate passes.
AVI_retention_gate.source: Permissive downloaded composite AVI only. Any gain cannot be attributed uniquely to AlphaGenome.

scope: Predeclared research validation and conditional release protection. Does not promise successful prediction, general coverage, disease causation or a Nature Communications-ready genetic manuscript.
version: V9 coverage-amended, before fresh outcome comparison
V9_baseline_amendment: Also compare against stronger training-only cell/culture-line median and require both baselines to pass.
V9_confidence_training_weighting: Equal study/cell stratum totals; source-omission original training roles only.

V9_minimum_local_confirmation.reason: Avoid treating a handful of local groups as confirmed preservation of nearby ranking.

V9_local_ranking_gate: Require both nonzero-difference ordering accuracy and paired-difference Spearman to drop by at most 0.01, in addition to sufficient local groups.
V9_project_release_scope: Not authorized by this assay-active-only experiment; diagnostic predictions remain separate from answers.
